CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.create_company_restriction_default()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
begin
  insert into public.company_restrictions(company_id) values(new.company_id);
  return new;
end;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.ensure_jobmate_role_profile()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
begin
  if new.role = 'job_seeker' then
    insert into public.job_seeker_profiles (user_id)
    values (new.user_id)
    on conflict (user_id) do nothing;

  elsif new.role = 'employer' then
    insert into public.employer_profiles (user_id)
    values (new.user_id)
    on conflict (user_id) do nothing;

  elsif new.role = 'administrator' then
    insert into public.administrator_profiles (user_id)
    values (new.user_id)
    on conflict (user_id) do nothing;
  end if;

  return new;
end;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.protect_jobmate_company_creator()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
begin
  if new.created_by is distinct from old.created_by then
    raise exception 'Company creator cannot be changed.'
      using errcode = 'P0001';
  end if;

  return new;
end;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.can_manage_company_jobs(p_company_id uuid)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
  select exists (
    select 1
    from public.users u
    join public.company_memberships cm
      on cm.user_id = u.user_id
    join public.companies c
      on c.company_id = cm.company_id
    where u.user_id = auth.uid()
      and u.role = 'employer'::public.user_role
      and u.status = 'active'::public.account_status
      and cm.company_id = p_company_id
      and cm.member_role in ('owner', 'employer')
      and c.verification_status = 'verified'::public.verification_status
  );
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.respond_to_job_application(p_application_id uuid, p_action text)
 RETURNS text
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
DECLARE
    v_actor_id uuid := auth.uid();
    v_application public.job_applications%ROWTYPE;
    v_job public.job_postings%ROWTYPE;
    v_new_status text;
BEGIN
    -- Lock the application to prevent concurrent changes.
    SELECT *
    INTO v_application
    FROM public.job_applications a
    WHERE a.application_id = p_application_id
    FOR UPDATE;

    IF NOT FOUND THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'Application not found.';
    END IF;

    -- Only the applicant may respond.
    IF v_actor_id IS NULL
       OR v_application.applicant_id <> v_actor_id
       OR NOT EXISTS (
           SELECT 1
           FROM public.users u
           WHERE u.user_id = v_actor_id
             AND u.role = 'job_seeker'::public.user_role
             AND u.status = 'active'::public.account_status
       )
    THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION
            'You are not authorized to manage this application.';
    END IF;

    -- Validate the requested action and current status.
    IF p_action = 'accept_offer'
       AND v_application.status = 'offered' THEN
        v_new_status := 'hired';

    ELSIF p_action = 'decline_offer'
       AND v_application.status = 'offered' THEN
        v_new_status := 'declined';

    ELSIF p_action = 'withdraw'
       AND v_application.status IN (
           'submitted',
           'shortlisted',
           'interview',
           'offered'
       ) THEN
        v_new_status := 'withdrawn';

    ELSE
        RAISE EXCEPTION
            'This action is not allowed for the current application status.';
    END IF;

    -- Retrieve job details for the notification.
    SELECT *
    INTO v_job
    FROM public.job_postings j
    WHERE j.job_id = v_application.job_id;

    IF NOT FOUND THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'Job posting not found.';
    END IF;

    -- Update application.
    UPDATE public.job_applications
    SET
        status = v_new_status,
        updated_at = now(),
        withdrawn_at = CASE
            WHEN v_new_status = 'withdrawn' THEN now()
            ELSE withdrawn_at
        END
    WHERE application_id = p_application_id;

    -- Record status history.
    INSERT INTO public.application_status_history (
        application_id,
        previous_status,
        new_status,
        changed_by
    )
    VALUES (
        p_application_id,
        v_application.status,
        v_new_status,
        v_actor_id
    );

    -- Notify the employer who created the job.
    INSERT INTO public.notifications (
        user_id,
        notification_type,
        title,
        message
    )
    VALUES (
        v_job.created_by,
        'application_' || v_new_status,
        'Application Response',
        'An applicant for '
            || v_job.title
            || ' has '
            || CASE v_new_status
                WHEN 'hired' THEN 'accepted the job offer'
                WHEN 'declined' THEN 'declined the job offer'
                WHEN 'withdrawn' THEN 'withdrawn their application'
               END
            || '.'
    );

    RETURN v_new_status;
END;
$function$
